title: Tech Note: Build Infinite Scroll of records with 4D Mobile
author: Xiang Liu, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note is built entirely on the 4D Mobile / Wakanda stack (Angular-Wakanda framework, Wakanda REST entity collections), which 4D has since fully discontinued in favor of ORDA-based REST and later Qodly for web/mobile app building; the pagination concepts ($top/$skip, lazy loading) remain generally valid but the specific APIs and framework shown no longer exist in current 4D offerings.
related_updates: 4D Mobile / Wakanda was discontinued; 4D moved to ORDA-based REST APIs consumable by any modern frontend framework
4D later introduced Qodly as its low-code web/app builder, replacing the Angular-Wakanda approach entirely
